message:
Command `cat > /workspace/candidate_trace.json << 'EOF'
[
  {"step": 1, "file": "fuzz/client.c", "function": "FuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 84, "var": "buf", "code": "if (SSL_do_handshake(client) == 1)", "note": "Fuzz target feeds raw TLS server response bytes into the client handshake.", "role": "source", "phase": "format"},
  {"step": 2, "file": "ssl/statem/statem_clnt.c", "function": "tls_process_key_exchange", "line": 2288, "var": "pkt", "code": "if (!tls_process_ske_dhe(s, pkt, &pkey))", "note": "Client processes ServerKeyExchange with DHE parameters from the server response.", "role": "propagation"},
  {"step": 3, "file": "ssl/statem/statem_clnt.c", "function": "tls_process_ske_dhe", "line": 2150, "var": "dh", "code": "if (EVP_PKEY_assign_DH(peer_tmp, dh) == 0)", "note": "DH object is assigned to peer_tmp; ownership of dh transfers to peer_tmp.", "role": "propagation"},
  {"step": 4, "file": "ssl/statem/statem_clnt.c", "function": "tls_process_ske_dhe", "line": 2157, "var": "EVP_PKEY_security_bits(peer_tmp)", "code": "if (!ssl_security(s, SSL_SECOP_TMP_DH, EVP_PKEY_security_bits(peer_tmp), 0, dh))", "note": "Security check fails because the DH prime is too small (bits < 80), triggering the error path.", "role": "propagation"},
  {"step": 5, "file": "ssl/statem/statem_clnt.c", "function": "tls_process_ske_dhe", "line": 2179, "var": "dh", "code": "DH_free(dh);", "note": "DH_free called on dh which is already owned by peer_tmp; this is the first free of the double-free.", "role": "root", "invariant": "DH object must not be freed twice"},
  {"step": 6, "file": "crypto/evp/p_lib.c", "function": "evp_pkey_free_it", "line": 877, "var": "x->ameth->pkey_free", "code": "x->ameth->pkey_free(x);", "note": "EVP_PKEY_free(peer_tmp) reaches evp_pkey_free_it which calls the DH pkey_free (DH_free) on the already-freed DH object.", "role": "propagation"},
  {"step": 7, "file": "crypto/dh/dh_lib.c", "function": "DH_free", "line": 128, "var": "r->references", "code": "CRYPTO_DOWN_REF(&r->references, &i, r->lock);", "note": "Second DH_free on the already-freed DH object decrements its reference count, writing to freed memory (heap-use-after-free WRITE 4).", "role": "sink"}
]
EOF
echo "trace written"; bash submit.sh /workspace/poc.bin /workspace/candidate_trace.json` executed with exit code 0.

message.content:
I see. `EVP_PKEY_free` calls `evp_pkey_free_it` which calls `x->ameth->pkey_free(x)`. For DH, `pkey_free` is `DH_free` (via the DH ameth). So the downstream consumer is `evp_pkey_free_it` at line 877 (`x->ameth->pkey_free(x)`), which calls `DH_free` → `CRYPTO_DOWN_REF` at `dh_lib.c:128`.

The crash state is `CRYPTO_DOWN_REF` → `DH_free` → `evp_pkey_free_legacy`. In this version, the function is `evp_pkey_free_it` (line 877). The downstream consumer that turns the double-free into a sanitizer-visible memory access is `evp_pkey_free_it` at `p_lib.c:877` calling `DH_free` on the already-freed DH object.

Let me update the trace to declare the downstream consumer as `evp_pkey_free_it` at `p_lib.c:877`, and the sink as `DH_free` → `CRYPTO_DOWN_REF` at `dh_lib.c:128`.
